ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Base your answers on the food web below and on your knowledge of biology. Which organisms are carnivores?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the upper left of the food web there is a fish, labeled “Piscivorous fish”; below it there is “Planktivorous fish”, and there is an arrow from the fish below pointing to the piscivorous fish above, indicating that it feeds on fish. The figure is also labeled with zooplankton, phytoplankton, protozoa, bacteria, DOM, CO2, etc. Reasoning: The question asks which organisms are carnivores. Carnivores refers to organisms that eat other animals; “piscivorous” means fish-eating, so the organism labeled “Piscivorous fish” in the figure is a carnivore.
